description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy for “instilled preferences” across two model categories under three conditions (Control, Before Introspection Training, After Introspection Training). The horizontal axis contains the categories “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini,” arranged left to right, with no explicit x-axis label; within each category, three adjacent bars form a grouped set. The vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” and uses a linear scale from 0.00 to 1.00, with regularly spaced tick labels at approximately 0.25 intervals (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). For GPT-4o, the Control bar is gray at roughly 0.10 with an error bar, the “Before Introspection Training” bar is teal at about 0.55 with an error bar, and the “After Introspection Training” bar is dark purple at about 0.74 with an error bar. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is gray near 0.00 with an error bar extending below and above zero, the “Before Introspection Training” bar is teal around 0.50 with an error bar, and the “After Introspection Training” bar is dark purple around 0.75 with an error bar. A legend in the upper-left maps gray to Control, teal to Before Introspection Training, and purple to After Introspection Training; the bars are not shown as sorted by value, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of error bars.
